title: A sprint orchestrator runs on Sonnet for one trial sprint, compared with Opus on cost and landings
goal: the orchestrator session of SP-rrqlgiff runs on Sonnet 5.5 as the trial; kb/_self/token-efficiency.md records a Sonnet orchestrator trial section that compares its cost, turns, landings, stops and hand fixes with those of the last three Opus-run sprints, read from the orchestrator sessions' results and the sprints' ops rows (backlog.py ops, cost --rework)

run:
import sys
def _fail(t, e, tb, _d=sys.excepthook):
    if issubclass(t, AssertionError):
        print("check failed:", e); sys.exit(1)
    _d(t, e, tb)
sys.excepthook = _fail
import re, sys
t = open("kb/_self/token-efficiency.md", encoding="utf-8").read()
m = re.search(r"(?m)^(#+ .*Sonnet orchestrator trial.*|.*\*\*Sonnet orchestrator trial.*)$", t)
assert m, "token-efficiency.md has no Sonnet orchestrator trial section"
rest = t[m.start():]
nxt = re.search(r"(?m)^#{1,3} ", rest[1:])
sec = rest[: nxt.start() + 1] if nxt else rest
low = sec.lower()
ids = set(re.findall(r"SP-[a-z0-9]{8}", sec))
miss = [w for w in ("cost", "turns", "land", "stop", "hand fix", "ops", "opus", "sonnet") if w not in low]
assert "SP-rrqlgiff" in ids and len(ids - {"SP-rrqlgiff"}) >= 3, ("the trial section does not name the trial sprint and three Opus-run sprints", sorted(ids))
assert not miss, ("the trial section does not compare each measure", miss)
assert "claude-sonnet-5-5" in sec, "the trial section does not name the orchestrator session's model as its result JSON gives it"
